stem: The velocity of a particle moving in the positive direction of x axis varies as $v = \alpha\sqrt{x}$, where α is a positive constant. Assuming that at moment t = 0, the particle was located at the point x = 0. Find the mean velocity of the particle averaged over the time that particle takes to cover first ‘$S$’ meters of the path.

assets.alt: Graph of v² against x: a straight line v² = α²x through the origin, reaching α²S at x = S. A note says the straight line means uniform acceleration a = α²/2.
